title: Evidential Multimodal Transformers with Dempster-Shafer Fusion for Emotion Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.13013v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Softmax-based multimodal emotion recognition methods often assign high confidence even when sensor data are corrupted or contradictory, for example when facial expressions suggest positive valence while vocal prosody indicates negative arousal. We present an Evidential Multimodal Transformer with Dempster-Shafer Fusion (EMT-DS) that addresses this problem through formal uncertainty quantification. EMT-DS models predictions as Subjective Opinions (Dirichlet distributions), separating epistemic uncertainty (lack of evidence) from aleatoric uncertainty (sensor noise). Modality-specific transformer encoders produce belief mass distributions that are fused with Dempster's Rule of Combination, which normalizes the joint belief mass by a conflict coefficient 1/(1-c), so that contradictory evidence is explicitly quantified as conflict and the fused prediction becomes diffuse rather than being forced into an unjustified consensus. translated_title: 基于Dempster-Shafer融合的证据性多模态Transformer情感识别方法
translated_abstract: 基于Softmax的多模态情感识别方法即使在传感器数据损坏或相互矛盾的情况下（例如面部表情显示积极效价而语音韵律表明消极唤醒时），仍常常给出过高的置信度。我们提出了一种带Dempster-Shafer融合的证据性多模态Transformer（EMT-DS），通过形式化的不确定性量化来解决这一问题。EMT-DS将预测建模为主观意见（Dirichlet分布），从而将认知不确定性（证据缺乏）与偶然不确定性（传感器噪声）分离开来。特定模态的Transformer编码器产生信念质量分布，并通过Dempster组合规则进行融合，该规则使用冲突系数1/(1-c)对联合信念质量进行归一化，从而将矛盾证据显式量化为冲突，使融合后的预测变得弥散，而不是被迫达成缺乏依据的一致结论。
tldr: 该论文提出EMT-DS模型，利用Dirichlet分布将预测建模为主观意见，并通过Dempster组合规则融合各模态证据，将模态间的矛盾显式量化为冲突、区分认知不确定性与偶然不确定性，从而避免了Softmax方法在传感器数据损坏或矛盾时仍给出过高置信度的问题，提升了多模态情感识别的可靠性与鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: EMT-DS is an evidential multimodal transformer that models predictions as Dirichlet-based subjective opinions and fuses modality-specific belief masses via Dempster's rule, explicitly quantifying contradictory evidence as conflict and separating epistemic from aleatoric uncertainty to enable robust emotion recognition under corrupted or conflicting sensor inputs.
